messages:
Anya (CS): Heads up — we are doing a proactive failover for a Dedicated GPU node in eu-west-1. Node gpunode-17 has logged repeated ECC/Xid errors and our health checks flagged it for drain. Drafting customer-facing comm below, please review: 

Samir (Infra): Thanks. Root cause looks like intermittent ECC spikes on the HBM bus, not thermal. We ran diagnostics; card passed basic hwcheck but errors reappeared after ~3h. Planning a hot-replace + node reprovision (no data plane exposure expected). Estimated impact: 5–10 min failover per instance, routing to spare capacity.

Mike (SRE): Confirming autoscale and routing policy will route live traffic to fallback pool. We'll set capacity reservation so no throttling. I'll run the swap during the 10:30-11:00 UTC window unless objections. Ops playbook: drain -> detach workloads -> attach replacement -> healthcheck -> uncordon.

Jess (Solutions): Wording suggestion for customer: keep it calm and operational. Avoid deep hardware jargon. Example: 

```
Hi <@acme-support>,

We wanted to let you know we've detected intermittent GPU hardware errors affecting a small number of Dedicated instances in eu-west-1. To minimize risk we will perform a brief failover and replace the affected GPU. During the work we expect a short disruption of up to 10 minutes while workloads are moved to healthy capacity. No data loss is expected.

Planned window: 10:30–11:00 UTC today. We'll post an update in this thread once the replacement is complete. Apologies for the inconvenience and please reach out if this window is problematic.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

Anya (CS): Nice. Add a note about rollback/fallback if any regression: "If we observe increased errors after failover we will reroute back and schedule a deeper maintenance with you." Also include contact path (SE oncall).

Samir (Infra): Ops detail for internal thread: spare pool has 6 GPUs, current margin 2. If one replacement fails, policy is to escalate to co-located region (eu-west-2) and open a hardware ticket with vendor. Replacement ETA vendor: 24–48h for shipped RMA if needed.

InfraBot: [alert] gpunode-17 ECC spike detected: Xid=31, count=47, last_seen=1782456700. Flagged for drain.

Mike (SRE): I'll create the maintenance job and post the final customer note 10 min before action. Anyone want to pre-approve now? :eyes:

Jess (Solutions): Pre-approve from my side. Small tweak: replace "intermittent GPU hardware errors" with "intermittent GPU hardware errors (memory ECC)" so it's clear but still concise. :+1:

Anya (CS): Final customer message queued. Sending at 10:20 UTC. Will paste a post-mortem summary here after the replacement. :white_check_mark:
